title.narrative: Supporting the promotion of circular economy practices on single-use plastic value chain

description.narrative: The project will support the initiative of the Government of Egypt to reduce plastic waste leaking into the environment, particularly by looking into product design stage of single-use plastic products including packaging based on circular economy practices. It will promote eco-design practices in industry and encourage to adopt greener material, products, and production process or greener technology as well as greener business models, with support of enabling policy, regulations or economic tools, while minimizing any adverse impact on the industry.
